text: Auroras appear when charged particles from the solar wind interact with gases in the upper atmosphere.
The colors of an aurora depend on atmospheric gases and the altitude of the collision.
Coffee beans are roasted seeds whose flavor depends on origin, roast, and brewing method.
Espresso is brewed by forcing hot water through finely ground coffee under pressure.
Lithium-ion batteries store energy through reversible movement of lithium ions between electrodes.
Battery capacity describes how much charge a cell can deliver under specified conditions.
Ocean currents transport heat around the planet and influence climate and ecosystems.
Tides are driven mainly by the gravitational effects of the Moon and Sun.
Volcanoes form when magma rises through weaknesses in Earth's crust and erupts at the surface.
Volcanic ash can affect air travel and climate when explosive eruptions reach the atmosphere.
A rainbow appears when sunlight is refracted, reflected, and dispersed by water droplets.
The visible colors of a rainbow are separated because each wavelength bends by a different amount.
